T-5.plan: Import all 1,240 help-center articles, chunk them and build the hybrid search index from ADR-001 (T-2).

progress.summary: A **scraper agent** pulled 1,240 articles from the help center (Zendesk export); a **cleaning agent** removed 86 outdated duplicates.
A **coding agent** built the chunker (400-token chunks, 15% overlap) and the hybrid index: 9,812 chunks, BM25 + embeddings.

completion.explanation:
Help center is indexed and searchable.

{{artifact}}

- **How:** scraper + cleaning agents for the import, a coding agent for chunking and the hybrid index (as ADR-001, T-2 decided).
- **Result:** 9,812 chunks; top-5 retrieval hit rate **94%** on 100 sample questions.
- Ready for the answer engine (T-9).

T-6.plan: Build the ticket API: receive tickets from customers' helpdesks, return answers, with API keys and rate limits.

progress.summary: A **coding agent** scaffolded `POST /v1/tickets` and `GET /v1/tickets/:id` with per-customer API keys.
A **test agent** wrote 31 tests; a **security agent** added rate limiting (60 req/min per key) and key rotation.

completion.explanation:
Ticket API v1 is live on staging.

- `POST /v1/tickets` → answer or hand-off, `GET /v1/tickets/:id` for status
- API keys per customer, 60 req/min rate limit, key rotation
- 31 tests green (coding, test and security agents)

The widget (T-11) and the hand-off (T-10) build on it.

T-7.plan: Build the embeddable chat widget following the support tone guide: theming, mobile, accessibility.

progress.summary: A **design agent** produced 3 widget layouts from the tone guide; picked the compact one (fits 320 px screens).
A **coding agent** built the widget as a 38 KB script with light/dark theming; an **accessibility agent** fixed 7 contrast and focus issues.

T-8.plan: Set up CI on every push and a staging environment for the beta.

progress.summary: A **devops agent** set up CI: lint, typecheck and tests on every push, about 3 min per run.
Staging deploys automatically from `main`; a **security agent** moved all secrets into the vault.

completion.explanation:
CI and staging are live.

- Every push: lint, typecheck, tests (about 3 min)
- Staging auto-deploys from `main`, secrets in the vault

The eval harness (T-12) will run in this CI.

T-9.plan: Build the answer engine on top of the index (T-5): retrieve, answer, cite at least one source, and score confidence for hand-off (T-10).

progress.summary: A **retrieval agent** tuned hybrid weights (0.4 BM25 / 0.6 vectors); a **prompt agent** wrote the answer prompt with mandatory citations.
Added a confidence score; below 0.6 the ticket goes to a human (T-10). An **eval agent** checked 100 tickets: 88% correct and cited.

completion.explanation:
Answer engine v1 is ready.

{{artifact}}

- **How:** a retrieval agent tuned search, a prompt agent wrote the cited-answer prompt, and an eval agent graded 100 tickets.
- **Result:** 88% correct and cited; every answer links its help-center source; low confidence hands off (T-10).
- Tuning continues in T-14 once the eval harness (T-12) runs on 200 tickets.

T-10.plan: Route low-confidence tickets to a human agent with a short context summary, through the ticket API (T-6).

progress.summary: A **coding agent** added the hand-off route: tickets below 0.6 confidence go to the customer's helpdesk queue.
A **summary agent** writes a 3-line context note for the human (question, what was tried, best sources).

completion.explanation:
Human hand-off works end to end: the answer engine's low-confidence tickets land in the helpdesk with a 3-line summary, so the human doesn't start from zero.

Coding and summary agents; built on the ticket API (T-6).

T-11.plan: Stream answers from the ticket API (T-6) into the chat widget (T-7), with sources shown under each answer.

progress.summary: A **coding agent** connected the widget to the API with streaming; the first words appear in about 400 ms.
Added source cards under each answer and friendly error states; a **test agent** covered 14 UI scenarios.

T-12.plan: Grade answers automatically against the eval rubric on 200 anonymised real tickets, inside CI (T-8).

progress.summary: An **anonymisation agent** removed personal data from 200 real tickets; a **labeling agent** wrote the expected answer and source for each.
A **coding agent** added the grader to CI (T-8): correct, cited and safe, per the eval rubric.

T-13.plan: Load-test the full system and write the go/no-go report for the beta.

progress.summary: A **load-test agent** simulated 50 concurrent customers: p95 answer time **2.1 s** (target < 3 s), zero errors.
A **report agent** combined the eval results (T-12, T-14), load test and hand-off stats into the go/no-go report.

completion.explanation:
**Recommendation: GO for the beta.**

{{artifact}}

- Accuracy 92% on 200 real tickets (after T-14), p95 2.1 s, 0 errors under load
- 74% of tickets answered without a human; the rest hand off with context (T-10)
- Risk: outdated help-center articles. Mitigation: weekly re-index (T-5 pipeline)

T-14.plan: Use the eval harness (T-12) to improve the answer engine (T-9) before the beta.

progress.summary: An **error-analysis agent** grouped the 28 failed tickets: 12 outdated articles, 9 missing sources, 7 multi-part questions.
A **prompt agent** added multi-part handling and a freshness boost for recent articles; a **retrieval agent** re-weighted titles.
